messages.text: Hi, how do I turn the lights off on the BS-4?  It's incredibly disrupting at night.
Searched the web · BS-4 miner LED lights off
Searched the web · BitFortun BS-4 LED lights settings

Hi, I'm Hal, HeliumDeploy's technical specialist.

The BS-4 can have three different lights on at night, and the fix depends on which one is bothering you:

1. **The RGB lighting.** The BS-4 has an ARGB controller, so this is the coloured glow.
2. **The front screen** that shows hashrate, temperature and shares.
3. **A small steady LED** on the power supply brick or on the board.

I haven't found any BitFortun documentation yet that says where the light controls are in the BS-4 dashboard, and I don't want to send you hunting for a menu that may not exist. So first, one quick check:

- Which of those lights is it? (A quick photo of the unit in the dark helps a lot.)
- Open the miner's dashboard in your browser by typing its IP address. The IP is usually on the screen, or in your router's device list. Then send me a screenshot of the Settings page and tell me the firmware version shown there.

With that I can tell you exactly what to change. If it turns out to be the power supply LED, nothing in the software controls that one. A small piece of electrical tape over it is the safe fix. Don't open the supply.
the RGB lighting on the fan

Thanks, that narrows it down. Here's what I found:

- BitFortun doesn't say anywhere I can find how to turn off the fan lighting on the BS-4. They've only published the code behind the BS-1's software, not the BS-4's.
- Our own free miner software, Harlo OS, doesn't support the BS-4 yet. It's listed as coming soon, so that's not an option today either.

I've passed this to JD, our hardware lead, so he can say whether the BS-4's built-in software can turn the RGB off. The team is online now and one of them will reply in this chat. Please stay here if you can. If you step away, you'll get the answer by email.

While you wait, it would help JD to see what your unit has:

1. Type the miner's IP address into your browser. The IP is usually shown on the miner's screen.
2. Look through the Settings page for anything called LED, RGB, Light or Display, and send me a screenshot.
3. Tell me the firmware version shown in the dashboard.

Please don't open the case to unplug the light cable. Opening the unit voids the warranty. For tonight, turning the fan side toward a wall will cut most of the glare without affecting cooling, as long as it still has a few inches of space to breathe.

The Discord is often the fastest way to get an answer: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf. Tag @nullhashrate (that's JD) there too.
